K12.name: Pear Tusk Earrings
K12.note: the two earrings sit on a small cream card printed STAINLESS STEEL, with a printed ring and two empty holes on it, held by a thumb, with a price and a code written over the photo: ignore the card, its printing and holes, the thumb and all the writing, and take only the pair of earrings.
K12.detname: IMAGE 2 is a close view of the LEFT earring of the same pair: the authority on the tapered tusk, the U-curl, the arm, the pear stone and its three claws.
K12.lock: A PAIR OF PEAR TUSK EARRINGS: each earring is ONE continuous piece of smooth, polished, round-section gold with no texture and no stones on the metal. Its main part is a long TAPERED TUSK that comes to a FINE POINT at the TOP and thickens downward to about 3mm. It bows outward like a crescent, so its point leans in over the stone side. At the bottom it turns in a tight U, and a thinner arm (about 2mm, thinning to 1mm) rises inside the curve and arches inward to hold ONE clear PEAR-cut faceted stone, about 9mm long and 7mm wide. The stone sits in the mouth of the curve, beside the lower part of the tusk, with an OPEN gap of about 3mm between them, so the curve never closes. It is set on a slant: its ROUND end is up and joined to the arm, and its POINT faces DOWN and in, away from the tusk. There are THREE claws per stone, SIX in all: TWO small round ball claws on the round end and ONE larger V-shaped claw over the point. A thin gold rim shows along one side of the stone. Each earring is about 22mm long and 15mm wide, so the stone fills the lower half of the earring's width. The post is hidden behind the tusk about 7mm below its tip. The pair is MIRRORED: on the left earring the tusk is on the left and the stone on its right; on the right earring the tusk is on the right and the stone on its left. The two tusks are on the outside, the two pears are in the middle pointing down towards each other, and the pair reads as ( ).
K12.neg: Exactly one stone per earring: a clear pear only, never round, never a marquise, never a heart, never coloured. The pear's point faces down and in, never up. Three claws only, never a bezel, a halo or pave. The tusk is plain smooth polished gold, never set with stones, never textured, twisted, hammered or flat. The earring is an open curve that never closes, never a closed hoop, never a huggie, never a ring round the lobe. No chain, no jump ring, no dangle: the stone is fixed and does not swing. No fish-hook ear wire. The two earrings are mirror images of the same size, never two identical earrings, and neither is turned narrower. No third earring.
K12.scale: Each earring is about 22mm long and 15mm wide, about one and a half fingernails tall. The pear is about 9mm long and 7mm wide, smaller than a fingernail. The tusk is about 3mm thick at its widest.
K12.wscale: Worn, the tusk stands upright on the front of the earlobe with its fine point just above the piercing. It runs down the lobe and curls under it, and the pear sits at the lower edge of the lobe, toward the cheek. The whole earring is about 22mm long, about a third of the ear's height.
K12.place: the two earrings lying face up side by side on the top face, mirror images of each other, the tusks on the outside with their points up and the pears in the middle, about a centimetre apart
K12.macro: one earring, the LEFT one: the tapered polished tusk with its fine point, the tight U-curl at its foot, the arm arching in, and the pear stone, point down, in its two ball claws and its V-claw

K13.detname: IMAGE 2 is a close view of the same necklace's jewelled front: the authority on the seven stones, the four bezels, the three-claw settings and the small rings and links between them.
K13.lock: A SEVEN STONE STATION NECKLACE: a FINE gold CABLE chain, about 1mm wide, its small oval links alternating face-on and edge-on, carries a jewelled front about 6.5cm long of SEVEN ROUND clear brilliant-cut stones, ALL THE SAME SIZE, about 4mm each, spaced EVENLY about 1cm apart centre to centre, in TWO ALTERNATING settings that start and end with a bezel: BEZEL, CLAW, BEZEL, CLAW, BEZEL, CLAW, BEZEL. FOUR BEZEL stations (the 1st, 3rd, 5th and 7th stones): each stone sits in a smooth plain polished round gold BEZEL cup about 5mm across, a thin gold rim lipped all round the stone, no claws. THREE CLAW stations (the 2nd, 4th and 6th stones): each stone is held only by THREE fine gold claws spaced evenly round it, no rim; two claws link to the neighbouring connectors and the THIRD claw is free and points OUTWARD from the curve. The CENTRE stone, the 4th and LOWEST, is a CLAW stone, its free claw pointing straight DOWN. Between every two neighbouring stations is the SAME short connector, about 5mm long: a small round gold jump ring about 2mm across, ONE small oval link, then a second small round jump ring. The plain cable chain leaves each END BEZEL from a small loop at the top of its rim. The front is MIRROR-SYMMETRIC about the centre stone: seven stones, four bezels, three claw settings, nine claws, six connectors.
K13.neg: Exactly SEVEN stones, never more, never fewer; all seven are round, clear and the SAME size, never graduated, never a bigger centre stone; bezels and claw settings ALTERNATE, both ends are bezels and the centre stone is in claws; the bezels are plain smooth gold, never pave, never beaded, never a halo; each claw stone has three claws, never four or six; the stones are linked by small rings and links and never touch, never a continuous tennis line; the chain is a fine cable chain, never rope, box, snake, paperclip or curb, never chunky; no pendant, no drop, no pearl, no coloured stone, no charm; no clasp or extender at the front.
K13.scale: Each stone is about 4mm across, about a third of the width of a fingernail; each bezel is about 5mm across; the stations are about 1cm apart and the whole jewelled front is about 6.5cm along the chain, about as long as a little finger; the cable chain is fine, about 1mm wide, a quarter of a stone's width.
K13.wscale: Worn, the necklace is delicate: the seven small stones, each about 4mm and much smaller than a fingernail, lie in a soft curve low on the neck at the centre of the collarbones; the jewelled front is about 6.5cm along the chain and covers only the middle of the neckline, about half the width of the neck.
K13.place: laid on the top face, the fine chain in a soft U and the seven stones in a gentle curve at its lowest point, the centre claw stone at the bottom
K13.macro: the centre of the jewelled front: the centre three-claw stone with its free claw pointing down, a bezel stone on each side, and the small round rings and oval links between them
K13.palm: the necklace lying in the centre of the open palm, the seven stones in a curve across the palm and the fine chain trailing over the fingers
K13.pscale: The jewelled front is a little shorter than the palm is wide; each stone is much smaller than a fingernail.
